intent: Individually teach electricity noun/mass use, pollution/pollute and less/fewer, plastic as material modifier, material/materials, purpose/on purpose versus accident/result, result linking structures, possible/possibly with uncertainty, and in the future without converting hope into evidence. A new original bag comparison supports exact coded material referents; count and measured-result boundaries remain text. Guided own writing, two rewrites and fresh numerical transfer grant no independent credit.
picturePurpose: A complete plastic carrier and complete blue cloth tote provide two distinct referents. Exact material labels and a reuse plan remain authored in code. No lifecycle, environmental benefit, durability or indefinite-reuse claim is inferred from the image.

workshop.title: 看材料、分词形、报告真正的结果
workshop.instruction: 先判断词形或观察记录，再填回句子，最后写自己的例句。看袋子时分清材料和数量；写结果时只说记录真正证明的内容。

items.label: electricity：节约的是电，修饰设备才用形容词
items.prompt: 值日生关掉不用的灯。要用表示“电”的名词完成建议，哪句正确？

wordDecision.prompt: 值日生关掉不用的灯。要用表示“电”的名词完成建议，哪句正确？

items.material: Turn off the lights to save electricity.
items.before: Turn off the lights to save
items.reason: electricity是名词，表示电，通常不可数：save electricity、use electricity。electric通常作形容词修饰设备，如an electric bike。先看句子需要事物名称还是修饰词，再选词形。
items.hint: electricity 是名词，electric 通常是形容词。

options.text: Turn off unused lights to save electric.
options.reason: electric通常是形容词，如an electric bike；本题需要名词electricity。

options.text: Turn off unused lights to save electricity.
options.reason: save后面这里需要表示电的名词electricity。

options.text: Turn off unused lights to save an electricity.
options.reason: 本题说电这种能源，electricity不可数，不能直接加an。

items.label: pollution：污染这件事与污染这个动作
items.prompt: 报告要说“少一点空气污染”和“工厂不能污染河流”。哪组分别用对了名词和动词？

wordDecision.prompt: 报告要说“少一点空气污染”和“工厂不能污染河流”。哪组分别用对了名词和动词？

items.material: Less traffic can help reduce air pollution.
items.before: Less traffic can help reduce air
items.reason: pollution是名词，泛指污染时通常不可数，用less pollution。pollute是动词，如Factories must not pollute the river。不要只认中文意思，要看空格在句子中需要名词还是动词。
items.hint: pollution 是名词；pollute 是动词。

options.text: less air pollution / Factories must not pollute the river.
options.reason: pollution是污染这种现象；must not后面用动词原形pollute。

options.text: less air pollute / Factories must not pollution the river.
options.reason: pollute不能在这里作现象的名称；pollution不能跟在must not后作动词。

options.text: fewer air pollutions / Factories must not pollute the river.
options.reason: 本题泛指空气污染，pollution不可数，用less air pollution；fewer修饰可数名词复数。

items.label: plastic：数袋子，还是说材料
items.prompt: 材料标签写明：左边是plastic bag，右边是reusable cloth bag。购物计划是少用塑料袋、多次使用布袋。哪句既符合计划，数量词也正确？

wordDecision.prompt: 材料标签写明：左边是plastic bag，右边是reusable cloth bag。购物计划是少用塑料袋、多次使用布袋。哪句既符合计划，数量词也正确？

art.alt: 左边是一只浅色薄膜购物袋，右边是一只蓝色织物手提袋；两只袋子分开摆放，袋身和提手完整，图中没有文字。材料标签由题目提供。

evidence.caption: 材料标签：左边plastic bag，右边cloth bag；数的是bags，用fewer。
仍对照两只袋子；bags可数，少一些袋子用fewer，材料总量才用less plastic。
两只袋子仍是相同的对象；图片没有证明所有塑料袋都能永久复用。

items.material: We use fewer plastic bags when we shop.
items.reason: a plastic bag是一个塑料袋，bags可数，少一些袋子说fewer plastic bags。plastic在这里修饰bags，说明材料。泛指塑料总量可说less plastic。图片只给出两只袋子的对应关系，不能证明材料的全部性能或环境影响。
items.hint: plastic 可修饰名词；a plastic bag 是可数的袋子。

options.text: We use less plastic bags and reuse our cloth bag.
options.reason: 本题数的是一个个bags；可数名词复数搭配fewer，不是less。说材料总量才可用less plastic。

options.text: This picture proves every plastic bag can be reused forever.
options.reason: 一张图不能证明所有塑料袋都能永久重复使用；这也不是计划给出的信息。

options.text: We use fewer plastic bags and reuse our cloth bag.
options.reason: 被计数的是bags，用fewer；plastic在这里说明袋子的材料。

items.label: material：一种材料与几种材料
items.prompt: 手工课只选一种材料；比较记录涉及三种材料。哪组单复数与数量一致？

wordDecision.prompt: 手工课只选一种材料；比较记录涉及三种材料。哪组单复数与数量一致？

items.material: Choose a material that can be used again.
items.reason: material说材料时，要看是否区分种类。选择一种材料可说choose a material；比较几种材料可说compare different materials。本题数量已经明确，先看a或three，再核对词尾。
items.hint: 指多种材料时可用 materials。

options.text: choose a materials / compare three material
options.reason: a后不能用复数materials；three后面这里要用复数materials。

options.text: choose a material / compare three materials
options.reason: a后用单数material；指三种材料时用复数materials。

options.text: material在任何语境下都不能变复数。
options.reason: 指不同种类的材料时可以用materials，不能把不可数用法扩大为所有用法。

items.label: purpose：事先想做什么，还是后来发生什么
items.prompt: 出发前，小组写下“认识本地树木”；途中有人不小心碰倒杯子。哪句正确区分了purpose与on purpose？

wordDecision.prompt: 出发前，小组写下“认识本地树木”；途中有人不小心碰倒杯子。哪句正确区分了purpose与on purpose？

items.material: The purpose of the walk is to learn about local trees.
items.after: of the walk is to learn about local trees.
items.reason: the purpose of...表示……的目的，常接is to do说明想达到什么。on purpose是故意，by accident是不小心。不能因为某事实际发生，就倒推它一定是原来的目的。
items.hint: on purpose 表示故意，不能与 for a purpose 混同。

options.text: The cup fell by accident, so it was knocked over on purpose.
options.reason: by accident是不小心，on purpose是故意，两者在本题中相反。

options.text: Any event during the walk must be its purpose.
options.reason: 途中发生了什么不一定是出发目的；目的要看事先想达到什么。

options.text: Learning about local trees is the purpose; the cup was not knocked over on purpose.
options.reason: purpose是事先的目的；on purpose是故意，不适用于本题的不小心。

items.label: result：用结果连接词时，原因写在哪里
items.prompt: 两句记录是“We turned off unused lights.”和“We used less electricity.”。要用as a result连接为因果关系，哪句正确？

wordDecision.prompt: 两句记录是“We turned off unused lights.”和“We used less electricity.”。要用as a result连接为因果关系，哪句正确？

items.material: We recorded the result of each small experiment.
items.reason: result是结果。As a result,后面接完整句，说明因此发生了什么；as a result of后面接名词或动名词，如as a result of turning off unused lights。先分清原因与结果，再选连接结构。
items.hint: as a result 表示因此、结果。

options.text: We turned off unused lights. As a result, we used less electricity.
options.reason: 先写关灯这一原因，再用As a result引出用电减少这一结果。

options.text: We turned off unused lights. As a result of, we used less electricity.
options.reason: as a result of后面要接名词或动名词，不能在of后直接加逗号接完整句。

options.text: We used less electricity. As a result, we had already turned off unused lights.
options.reason: 本题给出的因果方向是关灯后少用电，不能用As a result把已经发生的关灯倒写成结果。

items.label: possible：结构成立，也别把可能说成必然
items.prompt: 方案说“不买新东西也可能节水”，没有保证每次都能做到。哪句结构正确，也保留了这种可能？

wordDecision.prompt: 方案说“不买新东西也可能节水”，没有保证每次都能做到。哪句结构正确，也保留了这种可能？

items.material: It is possible to save water without buying anything.
items.after: to save water without buying anything.
items.reason: It is possible to do...表示做某事是可能的。possible是形容词；possibly是副词，可说We could possibly finish today，但本题不能直接替换possible。阅读时保留可能程度，别加上必然或每次这样的保证。
items.hint: possible 是形容词，possibly 是副词。

options.text: It is possibly to save water without buying anything.
options.reason: 这个It is...to do结构需要形容词possible；possibly是副词，不能这样替换。

options.text: It is possible to save water without buying anything.
options.reason: It is后面用形容词possible，后接to do；possible表达可能，并不保证每次必然实现。

options.text: We will certainly save water every time, even without changing anything.
options.reason: 原方案只说可能，没有给出certainly或every time的保证，也没说什么都不用改变。

items.label: future：将来的希望，不是已经证实的结果
items.prompt: 学生希望河流将来更清洁，还没有新测量结果。哪句既用对时间短语，也没有把希望说成事实？

wordDecision.prompt: 学生希望河流将来更清洁，还没有新测量结果。哪句既用对时间短语，也没有把希望说成事实？

items.material: We hope the river will be cleaner in the future.
items.before: We hope the river will be cleaner in the
items.reason: in the future表示在将来；本课按这个常见短语核对the。We hope...表示希望，不是已经验证的事实。别把希望中的未来状态改写成现在已经实现的结果。
items.hint: in the future 表示在将来，注意前面的定冠词。

options.text: We hope the river will be cleaner on the future.
options.reason: 表示在将来，本课用in the future；不能把介词in换成on。

options.text: Our hope proves that the river is already clean today.
options.reason: hope不等于测量证据；将来的愿望不能证明今天已经清洁。

options.text: We hope the river will be cleaner in the future.
options.reason: in the future表示将来；hope保留愿望，没有说结果已经得到证明。

transfer.stem: Which result is supported by the class record?
transfer.passage:
OUR CLASS PLAN
The purpose of our project was to use fewer plastic bags. We brought reusable cloth bags to the school shop. During the next week, we counted the new plastic bags we took: the number fell from twenty to twelve. We did not measure air pollution or the river water. We hope the river will be cleaner in the future, but our bag count cannot prove that it is clean today.

options.text: The class proved that the river was already clean.
The class took eight fewer new plastic bags in the next week.
The class took twelve fewer new plastic bags in the next week.
The class measured less air pollution and clean river water.

answer.display: The class took eight fewer new plastic bags in the next week.

explanation.strategy: 先找真正测量的对象和前后数量，再区分项目目的、实际结果和未来希望。

steps.text: 统计对象是新拿的塑料袋，数量从20降到12，少了8个。
steps.reason: twenty到twelve是两次数量，差值为20−12＝8；twelve不是减少量。

steps.text: 没有测量空气和河水，所以不能把将来的希望写成已经验证的结果。
steps.reason: did not measure明确测量边界；hope与in the future只表达未来愿望。

distractors.reason: 没有测量河水，未来希望也不能证明河流现在已经清洁。
12是后来拿的袋子数；减少量应算20−12＝8，不是12。
原文明确没有测量空气污染或河水，不能补出这两项结果。

explanation.pitfall: 目的、减少后的数量、减少量、未来希望是不同信息，不能互相代替。

visual.title: 想达到什么、测到什么、还没证明什么

segments.note: 未来愿望，不是今日事实

visual.caption: 只报告记录确实支持的结果；数量要算差值，结论要守住测量范围。

explanation.transfer: 如果后来统计为9个新塑料袋，比原来的20个少了几个？这能单独证明河水已经清洁吗？
